subject: Coordinating SE deep-dive and procurement clearance — StellarSys
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Zhou <mzhou@stellarsys.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SE deep-dive request (StellarSys)

Hi Jasmine / Soojin —

Following up from yesterday's discovery call with StellarSys (Michael & Priya). They want a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive where our SEs walk through an end-to-end inference flow (model selection, routing policy, and an initial cost/latency estimate). Procurement wants to attend for licensing/contract questions.

Quick asks:
- Soojin — can you take point on the tech walkthrough? Preferably demoing a small live workload and the Console dashboards.
- Jasmine — can you coordinate the calendar with the customer and include procurement/security stakeholders?
- Michael mentioned they might need us to sign a standard NDA and provide a security checklist before any environment access.

Proposed windows (PST): Tue 21 Jul 10:00–11:15, Wed 22 Jul 13:00–14:15, or Thu 23 Jul 08:30–09:45. Let me know availability and any prep materials we should send.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Michael Zhou <mzhou@stellarsys.com>, Priya Kumar <pkumar@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive request (StellarSys)

Hi Michael / Priya —

Thanks for the interest — happy to coordinate. Quick notes:
- SE lead: Soojin Lee (cc'd). Demo will cover: runtime topology, routing/fallback, demo of Console metrics, and a short QA on procurement/security requirements.
- Prep docs I'll attach: internal agenda, security checklist, and a draft SOW for scoping. Please review and we can redline.

Which of the three windows Aditya suggested works best? Also, Stephen in procurement — if you can confirm whether you need us to route a PO or go through a contract addendum that will help prep the SOW.

If it's helpful, we can limit the first 45 minutes to technical content and hold 20–30 minutes for procurement/security discussion.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Specialist, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Zhou <mzhou@stellarsys.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephen Grant <s.grant@stellarsys.com>, Priya Kumar <pkumar@stellarsys.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive request (StellarSys)

Jasmine — thanks. Wed 22 Jul 13:00–14:15 PST works best for our engineers and procurement (Stephen). We do need the security checklist up front and an NDA before you access our test environment. I've copied Stephen (procurement) who can confirm contractual flow — Stephen, we typically do a standard MSLA + PO for initial pilots.

Priya (engineering) — will join the session and can share a short list of integration points.

Can you send the invite with WebEx link and the attached checklist?

—Michael
Director of Engineering, StellarSys
From: Stephen Grant <s.grant@stellarsys.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive request (StellarSys)

Jasmine / Aditya —

Confirming procurement flow: StellarSys will issue a PO for the pilot once we have a signed MSLA. For the demo, we do not need a full signed contract but we do require the security checklist and a short statement of work that outlines pilot scope and deliverables. Please include estimated costs for a two-week eval in the SOW (ballpark is fine).

Also, our security team will request that any remote access uses our jump-host and that read-only dataset snapshots are used — no direct production access.

Stephen
Senior Procurement Manager, StellarSys
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Michael Zhou <mzhou@stellarsys.com>, Priya Kumar <pkumar@stellarsys.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + SE deep-dive request (StellarSys)

Thanks all — Wed 22 Jul 13:00 PST confirmed on my calendar. Agenda attached and a short checklist of what I'd like from StellarSys engineering to make the session productive:
- A minimal sample payload (anonymized) or schema description
- Access window to the test jump-host or a recording of the request flow if host access isn't possible
- Any firewall IP allowlist if we need to reach your test endpoints

Attachments: StellarSys_SE_Agenda_v1.pdf, security_checklist_stellarsys.xlsx

I'll demo: runtime topology, live Console traces showing token-level latency, and a quick quantization/cost tradeoff example. If you have 2–3 sample prompts or sequences Priya wants to see, send them ahead of time.

—Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Michael Zhou <mzhou@stellarsys.com>, Stephen Grant <s.grant@stellarsys.com>, Priya Kumar <pkumar@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: SE deep-dive + procurement sync (Wed 22 Jul 13:00 PST)

Thanks everyone — invite has been sent (WebEx link included). Attendees: Soojin (SE), Marissa (Solutions PM, will cover rollout/Console questions), Aditya (AE), Jasmine (coord).

Documents attached: SOW_draft_v2.pdf, StellarSys_SE_Agenda_v1.pdf, security_checklist_stellarsys.xlsx. Stephen — I'll follow up with the MSLA template and a ballpark estimate for a two-week pilot; feel free to redline the SOW.

Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Specialist, Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (draft), StellarSys_SE_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda), security_checklist_stellarsys.xlsx (security workbook)
